descriptions.w3d_sound_allocate_aligned: Allocates a block of the requested size with 32-byte alignment, likely for audio DMA buffers.
descriptions.w3d_sound_release_aligned: Frees a block obtained from the aligned audio allocator.
descriptions.w3d_audio_hardware_init: Appears to initialise the audio hardware: sets a mode, starts the audio interface and opens the mixer with fixed settings.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_list_get: Returns the global list that owns all sound sample objects.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_unlink: Removes a sound sample from the global sample list and decrements the list count.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_create: Allocates and constructs a new sound sample and registers it in the global sample list.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_type_get: Returns the type descriptor used to identify sound sample objects.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_release: Drops one reference to a sound sample; when none remain it unlinks and destroys it. Returns the remaining count.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_retain: Adds one reference to a sound sample and returns the previous count.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_cast: Checks or converts an object against the sound sample type descriptor via the generic type-cast helper.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_construct_801e1c80: Sound sample constructor: sets up the node, default name and path strings, clears fields and closes both streams.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_destroy_801e1d68: Sound sample destructor: frees lip-sync data, releases both strings, tears down the node and optionally frees memory.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_kind: Returns 2, likely the interface kind identifier for sound samples.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_name: Sets the sample's name string and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_18: Stores an integer sample setting (offset 0x18) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_18: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x18.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_40: Stores an integer sample setting (offset 0x40) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_40: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x40.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_path: Sets the sample's file path string and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_1c: Stores an integer sample setting (offset 0x1c) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_24: Stores a float sample setting (offset 0x24) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_28: Stores an integer sample setting (offset 0x28) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_2c_pair: Stores a pair of float sample settings (offsets 0x2c and 0x30) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_38_pair: Stores a pair of float sample settings (offsets 0x38 and 0x3c) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_34: Stores a float sample setting (offset 0x34) and reports success.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_lipsync_level: Returns the lip-sync level for a time in milliseconds from the sample's 60 Hz byte table, or a default when out of range.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_set_44: Stores the integer sample setting at offset 0x44.
descriptions.w3d_sound_sample_get_44: Returns the integer sample setting at offset 0x44.
